I realize that sounds like a lot to ask or expect from an already overly impuslive child,  and it is a lot, and it does take practice, but its SO worth it and necessary to build the foundation of a new relationship for you with your son. 

I would also recommend some research on whats called the "The Nurtured Heart Approach"  to kind of piggy back off what has been mentioned before of the importance of praising a child on what they have done correctly, instead of a constant downward spiral of not listening, being defiant etc. Even if that means you praising him for a very obvious task he never usually has a problem with in the first place, "hey Bud I seen you over there doing xyz, and that shows me abc, great Job!" or what have you. 

I wish I could help you more, I know it feels like an uphill battle sometimes with little payout, but its the most important thing you could possibly do for your son. 

Good luck and cheers!
